liner.body_md:
## Setlist highlights

- **Mirage City**: rare: 12 archived performances [6]

## The recordings

- **kglw2024-11-10_202410** (recommended): source not stated; 16 songs; 136 min [1]
- **kglw2024-11-10.dpa4018.flac24**: source not stated; 16 songs; 135 min [2]
- **kglw2024-11-10.dpa4011.flac24**: source not stated; 16 songs; 135 min [3]
- **kglw2024-11-10**: source not stated; 16 songs; 138 min [4]

## Around the show

- Introduced as a country song, featuring Stu on acoustic guitar and a jam [4]

## Tapers and lineage

- **kglw2024-11-10_202410**: taped by puffanug; transferred by puffanug; source: ADK Thor > PMD661 > 24/96 wav [1]. Also: ADK T7 THORs in ORTF cardioid, 100 feet from stage, eight and a half feet high; Signal passed through taper ted chopped xlrs into Oade concert mod Marantz PMD661 [1]
- **kglw2024-11-10.dpa4018.flac24**: taped by Scott Schneider; transferred by Scott Schneider; source: DPA 4018c(DIN/ROC at corner of FOH enclosure)->SD744T(24bit/96kHz) [2]
- **kglw2024-11-10.dpa4011.flac24**: taped by Scott Schneider; transferred by Scott Schneider; source: DPA 4011c(NOS/ROC at corner of FOH enclosure)->Sonosax M2D2(aes)->SD744T(24bit/96kHz) [3]
- **kglw2024-11-10**: taped by discocape; transferred by discocape; source: Schoeps cmc1k/mk21 [4]. Also: Schoeps cmc1k/mk21s in STC/ORTF, clamped to front right rail of board, by discocape [4]
